name: dataverse-contact-api
description: How the Dataverse Contact API actually works — URL shape, the me/team/all/public tiers, the permission grammar, the non-OData query dialect, Entra External ID auth, the @truenorth-it/dataverse-client SDK, and how to triage a 401/403/404/empty list. Use when writing or debugging any client against the Contact API. The shared factual reference behind dataverse-portal and dataverse-terraform.
